root_idea.summary: The root centers on severing, separating, or detaching something from something else.
root_idea.development: From physical cutting and separation, the lexicon extends to divided groups, severed relationships, crossing a boundary, portions detached from a whole, interruption, cessation, and bringing something to an end.

senses.definition: To cut, sever, or detach a physical thing from another.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of bodily members, trees, garments, entrails, and other tangible things; active and passive Quran forms express the cutting or its result.

senses.definition: To cut off or destroy a part, group, or remaining trace.
senses.usage_conditions: Includes cutting off a faction and eliminating a people or their last remnant; the passive may describe the resulting destruction.

senses.definition: To sever a bond, kinship, connection, or what is meant to remain joined.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of abandoning or breaking relations, including kinship and the ties commanded to be maintained.

senses.definition: To cross or traverse a route or body of water.
senses.usage_conditions: In the construction of crossing a river or water, the verb describes passage from one side to the other rather than physical cutting.

senses.definition: To obstruct a route and prevent travelers from proceeding along it.
senses.usage_conditions: The expression of cutting the road may mean intercepting or robbing travelers, thereby causing people to stop using the route.

senses.definition: To cut off a means or support, with the construction in 22:15 understood as cutting the suspended rope or ending one's life by hanging.
senses.usage_conditions: The interpretation of the Quranic construction is reported with alternatives, including cutting the rope and strangulation; it is not a general synonym for every use of the verb.

senses.definition: To cut up, sever, or divide something into pieces or portions.
senses.usage_conditions: The intensive/causative form presents the object as cut apart or partitioned, including bodily parts, garments, and other material wholes.

senses.definition: To divide a group or break apart a connected relationship.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of separating a people into divisions and of severing kinship or other social ties.

senses.definition: To become severed, divided, or separated from one another.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of bonds, communities, factions, and other connected entities that split apart or lose their former union.

senses.definition: To become cut into pieces or fragmented.
senses.usage_conditions: May describe a thing or an inward state becoming broken apart; the Quranic usage includes the figurative cutting of hearts into pieces.

senses.definition: Cut off, ended, or brought to an end.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, it describes the elimination of a people's last remnant and the negation of any ending or interruption from a provision.
In the Quranic construction, the active participle describes one who will not decide an undertaking without consultation.

senses.definition: A piece, section, or distinct portion of a whole; a separate tract or plot.
senses.usage_conditions: The supplied Quran form is plural and is used both for pieces and for distinct adjoining tracts of land.

senses.definition: A part or portion, especially a portion of the night.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic construction denotes passage or arrival during a portion of the night.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Griping or cutting pain in the bowels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily pain described as being in the abdomen.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Repeated interruption or breaking of the voice in singing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional description of interrupted vocal delivery.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To articulate or spell out a word.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexical use concerning deliberate separation of a word into articulated elements.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To separate oneself from another with the other's concurrence; to sever mutual friendship.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reciprocal construction describes two parties disuniting or breaking the bond between them.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become disintegrated through decay, become ragged, or separate into clots.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a wound or ulcer becoming dissundered, a garment or water-skin becoming tattered, or milk decomposing and coagulating.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become mutually disunited and sever the bond of friendship.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form VI construction, contrasted with maintaining connection or contact.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be cut short or become unable to continue.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a journey when means fail, and by extension of an argument, recitation, speech, or a person who can no longer proceed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To stop, cease, fail, become extinct, or come to an end.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes an activity, process, supply, or state that is interrupted or no longer continues.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To break off from, separate, or disunite oneself from someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction takes a person or associated party as the object of separation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To detach oneself from worldly things or other attachments.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reflexive use describing withdrawal from worldly concerns.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To devote oneself exclusively to, or withdraw to, a person or place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The prepositional construction is marked as figurative or assumed figurative in the lexical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cut off and take a portion for oneself, especially from another's property.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form VIII construction emphasizes appropriating a separated portion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pain in the belly, including colic or shortness of breath.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct vocalized noun from قِطْع and قِطْعَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A diminution or interruption of a well's water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression that a well has suffered a قُطْع, meaning that its water has decreased or ceased.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A designation applied to an arrow, especially a broad arrow point.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a distinct nominal use from قِطْع meaning a portion of night.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A detached group or portion of animals or insects.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a separate number of locusts, a herd, flock, or similar detached collection.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A piece or section of poetry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural قِطَع is used for sections of verse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lexical noun cross-referenced to a term for a severed piece or stump.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The supplied evidence gives only cross-references and does not provide an independent definition beyond them.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A herd, flock, troop, drove, or other distinct collection.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to collective groups of animals, birds, people, or similar beings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A whip cut from the skin of a camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete noun distinct from the collective meaning of قَطِيع.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A portion of land held in fee.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A landholding sense of the feminine noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Abandonment or forsaking, especially the severing of kinship.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression قَطِيعَةُ الرَّحِمِ denotes breaking or abandoning relations, the opposite of maintaining kinship ties.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person decisive and energetic in handling affairs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive descriptive form applied to a man who deals forcefully or decisively with matters.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Unable to reply.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative expression for being left without an answer or unable to respond.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The cut, shape, conformation, proportion, or stature of a person or thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May describe facial lineaments, bodily build, beauty or proportion of stature, or the shape and fashion of an object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place where a river, desert, or similar expanse is crossed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural مَقَاطِع is used for such crossing places.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The place of articulation or utterance of a letter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A phonetic and grammatical use, comparable to a point of emission.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cause or means of cutting off or stopping something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for an instrument or circumstance that terminates or checks an activity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Made by cutting out or assembling several pieces.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of garments formed from multiple cut pieces.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Clipped, debased, underweight, or heavily broken coins.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of damaged or adulterated currency.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The separated letters of the alphabet.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional designation for the alphabetic letters as distinct units.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A grammatical exception whose excepted item is disunited in kind from the class mentioned before it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical grammatical term contrasted with a connected exception.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Heads or points of spears and arrows.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural technical noun for weapon points.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The lower or rearmost ends of valleys.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized geographic expression for where valleys terminate.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To grant someone branches or authorize him to cut them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of permitting a person to cut and take branches from a vine or similar plant.

cautions: The Form I QAC group aggregates mostly active forms with one passive occurrence; the public headword is therefore normalized to the dictionary citation form قَطَعَ.
The QAC feminine passive participle مَقْطُوعَة and feminine active participle occurrence قَاطِعَة are presented under their normalized citation forms.
The construction in 22:15 has more than one reported interpretation, including cutting a rope and hanging or strangulation; the example should not be read as resolving that interpretive question.
